svg.title: SDOF isolator model and transmissibility curve
svg.text: machine force F(t) → force into the floor F_T
floor motion y(t) → machine motion x(t)
Same curve for both cases: T = F_T/F0 = x/y
ζ 0.30: less isolation at high r
HMC on rubber mounts vs 50 Hz: r 2.87, T 0.152
grinder on rubber vs 12.3 Hz: r 0.77, T 2.39 (WRONG)
HMC rigid pads vs 50 Hz: r 0.45, T 1.26
SDOF isolator model and transmissibility curve
EXAMPLE – check the maker's installation manual
